as_told.title: Jake Barber's predicted egg demonstration and Sky Watcher

plain: A public demonstration of calling down UFOs, which the government now calls unidentified anomalous phenomena, was planned for the first half of 2025, according to Jake Barber, a former helicopter pilot who says he once carried a recovered craft. Barber told Michels in January 2025 that his group hoped to do it within months, which would show the phenomenon could be summoned on demand. More than a year later, Michels himself said that Barber apparently "didn't land another egg," meaning an egg-shaped craft, as he had predicted.
